data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Rashwa' which means soft, gentle, calm and serene. It is a name for a girl who embodies these qualities. The name Rashwa carries the meaning “Soft, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rashwa usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rashwa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashwa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رشوة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الرشوة أو الفائدة غير المشروعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشوة هي اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذر اللغوي 'ر-ش-و' والذي يعني الرشوة أو الفائدة غير المشروعة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا المصطلح لوصف الفعل الذي يقوم به الشخص لتقديم أو تلقي مال أو فائدة من أجل الحصول على شيء غير مشروع. وفي سياق التسمية، قد يكون الاسم مشتقًا من معنى الإكرام أو العطاء بطريقة مشروعة.

In Islamic tradition, the term is associated with the act of giving or receiving money or favors in exchange for unfair advantages. The name may also imply a sense of generosity or gift-giving within legal and ethical boundaries. Historically, the concept has been addressed in Islamic jurisprudence as a form of corruption. As a name, Rashwa may symbolize the importance of integrity and lawful conduct.
